description:
Server-authoritative buyer QUOTE (safe scope price_quote; OAuth grant). Integer line items + a single-use time-limited quote_token bound to your account. QUOTE ONLY: no order, no payment, no funds locked, no stock reserved (availability re-checked at real order creation).
Uses your SAVED default address server-side (never returned); no default → DEFAULT_ADDRESS_REQUIRED (never paste an address into chat).
Amounts are INTEGER base-units (exp 6) — never sum lines yourself. payment_rail: direct_p2p (live; you pay the seller directly, WebAZ holds no funds) | usdc_escrow (on-chain escrow, channel-gated). The compatibility-only escrow input is rejected. Ineligible rails FAIL — never auto-switched.
payment_options = price per method; pick lowest payable_units: direct_p2p → account_id as direct_receive_account_id; usdc_escrow → payment_rail.
Variants: if the product has variants and the user has not chosen one, show the options with prices and ask first; never pick one yourself.
quote_token: 10-min single-use, bound to you+product+quantity+address+rail+amounts. Next: webaz_order_draft → webaz_submit_order_request → the human approves on webaz.xyz.

address_source.description: Only 'default' in v1 — your saved default address, resolved server-side, never shown.

direct_receive_account_id.description: direct_p2p only: a known ACTIVE receiving account of this seller (no free-text payment instructions).

donation_bps.description: Integer basis points (0/0.5%/1%/2%/5%), charged IN ADDITION to total. Never auto-set.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client key: same subject+key+payload within TTL returns the SAME quote; same key with a different payload → IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

offer_id.description: RFC-032 negotiated offer (off_…) for your human: prices the quote at min(offer, listing), answers price_basis:"offer" + list_price_units_at_offer + offer_expires_at, expires no later than the offer, and carries it through draft → approval → order. Consumes nothing. See place_order's offer_id for the full rule.

options.description: Instead of variant_id: {dimension: value} per variant_dimensions

payment_rail.description: direct_p2p (live) | usdc_escrow (on-chain, channel-gated). The compatibility-only escrow input is rejected. Ineligible rails fail — never auto-switched.

product_id.description: Active listing id (server re-reads product + seller state)

quantity.description: Positive safe integer (default 1). Strings/decimals rejected — no implicit conversion.

variant_id.description: Required when the product has variants

name: webaz_quote_order

outputSchema.description: webaz.order_quote.model.v2 — consumer quote projection: USDC price + display-only fiat estimate, region-only destination, rail-honesty note. Quote only — nothing charged, no stock held

error.description: present ONLY on failure (with error_code + structured recovery fields)

fiat_estimate.description: display-only ≈local-fiat {currency,display,rate,as_of,stale}; never a settlement amount; omitted when unavailable

options.description: VARIANT_REQUIRED only: bounded active in-stock SKU choices {variant_id,sku?,options,price,stock_status}; choose explicitly, never guess

price.description: product price: amount_minor / currency USDC / display (display line only; fx table gives display-only local conversions)

quantity.description: positive integer, or null when invalid (see quantity_valid); display-only (amount=price.amount_minor)

quantity_valid.description: false only when quantity is invalid data (card shows 数量数据异常, buttons disabled)

rail_note.description: per-rail honesty note: escrow(WAZ)=simulated; usdc_escrow=real USDC in the Base contract; direct_p2p=no principal held

selection_required.description: VARIANT_REQUIRED only: the buyer must choose a variant before retrying

status.description: v2 status {code,label,label_en}; code canonical (never from label)

variant_options_total.description: VARIANT_REQUIRED only: total active in-stock SKU choices

variant_options_truncated.description: VARIANT_REQUIRED only: true when the bounded options array omits additional choices
